introHeading: The enclosed booth in Williamsburg's loft parties
introParas: Most of what we bring to Williamsburg is built to be seen — a mirror on a rooftop, a glam booth under string lights. The enclosed booth does the opposite on purpose. It's a curtained cabinet guests step into and pull shut, away from whatever's happening in the rest of the loft, which is exactly why the strips that come out of it look nothing like the posed group shot from ten minutes earlier. Behind the curtain sits a pro-grade DSLR and studio lighting tuned for a small space, so the print stays crisp no matter what the venue's ambient lighting is doing.

The cabinet's footprint works in the neighborhood's favor. It fits through a single freight-elevator trip off Berry Street with room to spare, and it tucks into a corner of an East Williamsburg loft without competing with the bar or the DJ setup for space — a real advantage over a bulkier rig when a converted industrial building's load-in is one elevator car and a short window before the next act needs the same path. A 10ft x 10ft spot near the party is ideal, we can work with 8ft x 8ft when a loft floor runs tighter than expected, and all it needs nearby is a standard outlet.

It's a regular at Williamsburg weddings, milestone birthdays and bar and bat mitzvahs, and for a corporate party the exterior wraps in your branding so the booth itself becomes part of the activation. Couples and small groups fit comfortably behind the curtain — for a bigger group shot, pair it with an open-air booth and let the enclosed booth handle the photos people actually take home. There is no travel fee anywhere in Williamsburg, and your strip template is designed for your event before we arrive.

faqHeading: Enclosed Photo Booth in Williamsburg — FAQ

faqs.q: Why choose the enclosed booth over the mirror or glam booth for a Williamsburg loft party?
faqs.a: Privacy changes what people do in front of a camera. Behind the curtain, guests loosen up in a way they don't in front of a booth the whole room can see, and the strips show it. If you want equipment people watch from across the room, the mirror or glam booth does that better; if you want the photos your friends keep taped inside a scrapbook, the curtain earns its space.

faqs.q: Does the enclosed booth fit through a Berry Street building's freight elevator?
faqs.a: Yes. The cabinet's footprint is compact by design, so it clears a single freight-elevator trip without being taken apart — the standard load-in for most converted industrial spaces off Berry.

faqs.q: Is the enclosed booth a good fit for a tight East Williamsburg loft?
faqs.a: It's one of our easiest booths for that kind of space. Loft venues off Berry and Kent often have a floor plan already split between a bar, a DJ setup and a dance area, so a compact cabinet that tucks into a corner is a real advantage over a bulkier rig.

faqs.q: How many people fit inside the booth at once?
faqs.a: Couples and small groups fit comfortably, and part of the fun at a wedding or Sweet Sixteen is seeing how many friends can squeeze in for one strip. For a bigger group shot, we usually pair the enclosed booth with an open-air booth so both kinds of photo happen.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee to Williamsburg?
faqs.a: No travel fee anywhere in Williamsburg. We quote it from your venue ZIP code before you book, so there is nothing to discover on the invoice afterward.

faqs.q: How much space and power does the enclosed booth need?
faqs.a: A 10ft x 10ft spot is comfortable and leaves room for the line that forms once strips start circulating. We can compress to 8ft x 8ft when a Williamsburg venue runs tight, and we need a standard 110V, 5-amp, 3-prong outlet within 15 feet, ideally not shared with the DJ.

faqs.q: How long does setup take, and what if you need to arrive early?
faqs.a: About 20 minutes once we're on site, and we build in a full hour before your start time so it's tested and quiet before guests arrive. If your Williamsburg venue needs us there earlier for a strict loading window, idle time runs at $150 per hour.

faqs.q: Can the enclosed booth be branded for a Williamsburg corporate event?
faqs.a: Yes. The exterior of the cabinet can be wrapped in your branding, and the strip template carries your logo or campaign graphics, so the booth itself becomes a piece of the activation rather than a neutral prop in the room.
